spec.name: Furniture Coat Stand
spec.description: A freestanding dark spruce coat stand with four chunky upturned hooks, a grounded cross base, a tan felt hat and an orange scarf draped over the front hook. Axis-aligned construction, distinct editable cube nets, and warm survival-furniture proportions.

elements.name: Tan hat crown with painted band
Orange scarf folded over front hook

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: freestanding dark spruce coat stand with four chunky hooks, stable cross base, one tan hat and a hanging orange scarf. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
